text: To the overseer; of David. In Jehovah I put my trust: how will ye say to my soul, Wander ye to your mountain, little bird?
For behold, the unjust will bend the bow, they prepared their arrow upon the cord, they will shoot in darkness the upright of heart.
If the pillars shall be pulled down, what did the just one?
Jehovah is in his holy temple; Jehovah, in the heavens his throne: his eyes will behold, his eyelashes will try the sons of man.
Jehovah will try the just one: and the unjust and him loving violence, his soul hated.
He will rain upon the, unjust, snares, fire and brimstone, and a wind of violent heat: the portion of their cup.
For Jehovah the just loved justice; his face will behold the upright.
